data: {"card": {"id": "entropy-oj", "title": "Entropy Online Judge", "subtitle": "Competitive Programming & DSA Platform with Socratic AI Debugging", "summary": "A competitive-programming platform that compiles and evaluates C++17 and Python 3.11 submissions in an isolated Linux environment, featuring progressive AI debugging hints and problem auditing.", "role": "Solo Author (AlgoUniversity Externship)", "tech_stack": ["React 19", "TypeScript", "Node.js", "Express", "MongoDB Atlas", "Redis", "BullMQ", "C++17 / GCC", "Linux Runner", "Azure VM", "Groq"], "highlights": ["Asynchronous execution queue: BullMQ and Redis decouple code judging from HTTP handling, offloading jobs to a dedicated worker.", "Socratic Hint Engine: Passes only public sample cases and student code to LLM, stripping full solutions and protecting hidden suites.", "Provider fallback: Resilient workflow switching across Gemini Flash, Groq, and OpenRouter with structured JSON output repair.", "Monaco Editor integration for in-browser IDE experience with real-time compilation and runtime diagnostics."], "metrics": {"Worker Model": "Decoupled Redis/BullMQ", "Supported Languages": "C++17 (GCC), Python 3.11", "Sandboxing": "Linux OS Limits & Dedicated VM", "Deployment": "Vercel + Render + Azure VM"}, "github_url": "https://github.com/aamir-coding/entropy-oj", "live_url": "https://entropy-oj.vercel.app", "source_sections": ["J1", "J2", "J4", "J5", "J6"], "architecture_details": "### System Architecture
The React client connects to an Express API deployed on Render.
Submissions are persisted in MongoDB Atlas and pushed to a BullMQ queue
backed by Redis on an Azure VM.

```
[React 19] ──HTTP──► [Express API] ──Enqueue──► [Redis / BullMQ]
                                                       │
                                                  Worker Pull
                                                       ▼
[MongoDB Atlas] ◄──Persist Result── [Linux Sandbox Runner (GCC/Python)]
```

### Key Architectural Decisions & Trade-offs
1. **Asynchronous Queue over HTTP Blocking:** Judging untrusted code
   can take seconds. BullMQ worker execution ensures API endpoints
   respond in <50ms with a submission ticket.
2. **Linux Process Controls:** Sandboxed execution via process limits
   (RLIMIT_CPU, RLIMIT_AS) prevents denial of service while avoiding
   container spin-up overhead.
3. **Socratic Guardrails:** AI endpoints only inspect public sample
   cases to prevent test leakage."}}
